projects.title: VoxFlow Studio
projects.description: Multi-provider neural speech studio. Synthesises and transcribes through Deepgram, Cartesia Sonic, ElevenLabs and Gemini from one desk, with an archive of every take.

projects.title: Dubber Web Studio
projects.description: Real-time voice dubbing in the browser. Speaks one language, hears another, with live subtitles and system-audio capture for video.

projects.title: Dubber
projects.description: The flagship edge build of the dubbing suite. Eleven languages out, twelve voices in, running serverless on Cloudflare Workers.

projects.title: SQL Quest
projects.description: Learn SQL by writing it. A graded curriculum from first SELECT to normalisation and indexes, with every answer checked the moment you submit it.

projects.title: ATMR Drop
projects.description: Cross-device transfer with no accounts and no setup. Peer-to-peer files up to 10 GB and clipboard sync, encrypted on the client before it ever leaves the device.

projects.title: MindStream
projects.description: A note app built for restless minds. Dump a raw thought by voice or keyboard, let the AI tidy it later, and keep it local-first with optional Cloudflare sync.

projects.title: LLM Chat
projects.description: One chat window, many models. Switch between Groq and OpenRouter mid-conversation, compare answers side by side, and preview generated code inline.

projects.title: Grouper
projects.description: Paste a roster, get balanced groups. Sorts a cohort into fair teams for breakout sessions, then seeds tournament brackets from the result.

projects.title: Project Archive
projects.description: This archive, running at the edge. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers over a D1 database, serving the same catalogue to web and Android from one source.

projects.title: Voice Actors (APK)
projects.description: The neural speech studio as a signed Android app. Over-the-air updates, hardware back navigation, TTS profiles and an offline audio engine.

projects.title: Dubber (APK)
projects.description: Dubber in your pocket. A one-tap language bar, subtitles-first stage and the same translation engine as the web studio, packaged for Android.

projects.title: ATMR Drop (APK)
projects.description: The Android client for Drop. Hooks into the system share sheet, records audio in the background and keeps the same client-side encryption as the web app.

projects.title: Selected Work (APK)
projects.description: This archive as a native Android app. Updates itself in place, keeps the catalogue offline, and adds hardware back navigation throughout.

projects.title: Mr Pasta
projects.description: A working menu system, not a PDF. 212 dishes with live sync, a waiter scanner, bilingual French and Arabic, and an admin panel with backup and restore.

projects.title: L'Hacienda El Djazaïr
projects.description: Turkish grill house in Sétif. Royal charcoal grillades and Ottoman gastronomy across forty creations, open around the clock with table service.

projects.title: Vitalia
projects.description: Italian pizzeria in Sétif. Pizzas, burgers and tacos with live size selection, add-ons and a running order total that survives a page refresh.

projects.title: L'Asiatico
projects.description: Asian fusion and sushi in Sétif. Gourmet sushi rolls, nems, yakitori skewers and wok noodles, browsable by course with a basket that totals as you go.

projects.title: Original Frenchy
projects.description: Gourmet fast food in Sétif. French tacos, smash burgers, white-sauce wood-fired pizzas and Parisian crêpes, in a menu that loads fast on a phone.

projects.title: Five Pizza
projects.description: Pizza, tacos and hamburgers in Sétif. A searchable catalogue with sizes, supplements and a cart, built to stay quick on a slow connection.

projects.title: Crousty One
projects.description: Crispy boxes, tacos and sandwiches. A fullscreen bilingual menu with add-on pricing and a cart, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

projects.title: Kunafista
projects.description: Kunafa done properly. A premium dessert house menu in French and Arabic, with a basket and the same warm visual language as the restaurant.

projects.title: Rollz
projects.description: Artisan rolled ice cream, tiramisu and cookie fries. A tap-to-explore premium menu with a bilingual interface and live cart.

projects.title: SOLYT Café
projects.description: A café menu at Park Mall Sétif. Seventy-nine choices of coffee, mocktails, milkshakes and crêpes, with opening hours and directions on the landing card.

projects.title: Broaster
projects.description: Broasted chicken restaurant menu. Plates, sandwiches, galettes and pizzas in a bilingual fullscreen layout with social links and contact.

projects.title: Marwa Dream
projects.description: A haute couture house in Algiers. Evening gowns, linen separates and luxury leather goods, with express delivery across all 58 wilayas and cash on delivery.

projects.title: Amira Beauty
projects.description: A hair care salon in Sétif. Protein, keratin and botox treatments, colour and balayage, booked by appointment through a Cloudflare Worker and D1 admin space.

projects.title: Stélane Coiffure
projects.description: A mixed salon in Villemomble. Cuts, colour, balayage and extensions with an appointment request flow, a services page and today's opening status.

projects.title: QuantumForge 3.0
projects.description: A falling-sand physics playground with living ragdolls. Nuclear reactors, dam breaks and zero-gravity orbits, all running at sixty frames a second in the browser.

projects.title: Aerokinetic 9X
projects.description: Take a tactical sidearm apart in 3D. An exploded schematic of a 4140 steel slide assembly with real-time kinetic physics and touch inspection controls.

projects.title: CosmoPulse
projects.description: An audio-visual particle sandbox. Canvas particles that answer to gravity, vortex and black-hole modes, scored by a pentatonic synthesizer you can play.

projects.title: Politics
projects.description: A social deduction party game. Secret roles are dealt automatically and the table has to work out who is on their side, with Mr White and Serial Killer modes.

projects.title: Politics (Classic)
projects.description: The first build of Politics, kept as a record. The same deduction rules in a leaner shell, with the original role deck and discussion flow.

projects.title: A.T.M.R Games
projects.description: Five games of chance and memory. Coin flip, Russian roulette, random numbers, a memory challenge and rock paper scissors, all in one launcher.

projects.title: Scale & Perspective
projects.description: Put a number in physical perspective. Compare masses, volumes and proportions side by side on calibrated 3D and 2D studio pedestals, from a rice grain upward.

projects.title: GPH Navette
projects.description: A driver's shift ledger for the perfumery factory shuttle. Logs each worker and route as it happens, tracks what is still owed, and works from cache when the signal drops.

projects.title: Outreach Control Deck
projects.description: A B2B dispatch desk for cold outreach. Verifies every address with a full SMTP handshake before sending, de-duplicates the queue and scores leads with no website required.

projects.title: Telegram Groq Assistant
projects.description: A Telegram bot that answers at Groq speed. Runs as a webhook on the Workers edge over LLaMA 3.3 and Mixtral, with a canvas view for longer replies.

projects.title: QR Code Generator
projects.description: Turn any link or text into a code, with styling controls and vector output for print. No sign-up, no watermark, no catch.

projects.title: Free Media Heck Yeah
projects.description: The internet's largest index of free software, media and creator tools. A community-maintained reference that earns its place in any toolbox.

projects.title: Aymen Draidi — Portfolio
projects.description: A personal site for a digital innovation specialist. Full-stack development and growth services, reachable in one tap by phone, WhatsApp, Telegram or Viber.

projects.title: 3ATMR Creative Hub
projects.description: The original archive and creative playground. Kept as a live record of where the catalogue began, before it moved to the Workers and D1 stack.

projects.title: Kunafista Admin
projects.description: The back office for the Kunafista menu. A customer view and an admin panel side by side, built to show how the menu would be run day to day.

projects.title: English Level Test
projects.description: An English proficiency test that grades itself. Reading, vocabulary, grammar and writing sections, unique candidate codes, and QR sharing for students on mobile.

projects.title: SportyShop DZ
projects.description: A storefront demo for an Algerian sports boutique. Footwear, apparel and accessories across three languages, with category browsing and a checkout flow.

projects.title: Rebuild Training
projects.description: A strength programme built around one condition. Legs and abs with prescribed rep ranges, a form checklist per set, and progress that survives a refresh.

projects.title: Preem Calories
projects.description: Calorie and macro tracking with a diamond edge. Daily budgets, meal logging, BMI and a progress history, in a dark interface that stays out of the way.

projects.title: VoidCall
projects.description: A tactical chess battler with a card layer. Six faction decks, solo against the Void AI or two players passing one device, with a codex of twenty-seven cards.

projects.title: AETHEL Gallery
projects.description: A curated image gallery with a moderation desk. Categorise, caption and publish works, then track views, likes and ratings from one admin panel.

projects.title: Secret For Calu
projects.description: A birthday portal dressed as a security breach. An Overwatch-themed identity check gates the message, with retro synthesised audio and a custom soundtrack.

projects.title: Visual Harvest
projects.description: Batch image harvesting from stock libraries. Filter by size, aspect ratio and colour, then pull whole search result sets in one pass.

projects.title: Cisco IOS Layers Visualizer
projects.description: A revision aid for the Cisco IOS modes. Walk from user EXEC to privileged EXEC and configuration in a simulated console that explains what each level allows.

projects.title: Blockchain Revision Hub
projects.description: A study desk for blockchain fundamentals. Flashcards, a slide deck and a forty-question quiz across easy, medium and hard, with lecture notes alongside.

projects.title: Story Detective
projects.description: An AI mystery generator. Each round invents an accident and hands you the case file to interrogate, with characters and clues written on the fly.

projects.title: VoidMass Card Demo
projects.description: A card battler prototype. Draw, deploy troops to a grid and pick a perk between rounds — an animation and interaction study more than a finished game.

projects.title: WuWa Calculator
projects.description: A damage calculator for Wuthering Waves. Enter crit rate and crit damage to see what a build actually yields before you commit the materials.

projects.title: Numedians
projects.description: A club site for a university society. Member resources and society information, built as a first client project and kept as an archive piece.
